in_marathi.name: Tejraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of Fire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tejraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tejraj is a Sanskrit name for a boy, meaning 'Ruler of Fire'. This name is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Tej' which means 'Fire' and 'Raj' which means 'Ruler'. It is a powerful and authoritative name, reflecting the strength and wisdom of those who bear it.
